cases.text: We found that floor area increased.

cases.text: Previous studies found that floor area increased.
cases.note: Prior-work result, not suppressed.

cases.text: A review concluded that floor area is associated with satisfaction.
cases.note: Review-style result; 'concluded' not in lexicon.

cases.text: We hypothesized floor area and found satisfaction.
cases.note: Hypothesis + result in one sentence; attaches to the result only.

cases.text: We suggest that floor area increased.
cases.note: 'suggest' not in the mapper lexicon; only 'increased' matches.

cases.text: We found that floor area increased and detected a change in satisfaction.
cases.note: Three raw hits (found, increased, detected). The gap before 'increased' is 'that', so it merges into 'found'. The gap before 'detected' is 'and' (the nearer boundary word, since 'that' lies further back before 'increased'), so 'detected' splits off as its own local assertion.

cases.text: We did not find that floor area increased.
cases.note: CORRECTED after the first run: '_RESULT_PREDICATE' lists only past-tense 'found', never the base form 'find' correct do-support negation requires -- see ho_negation_agnostic's note.

cases.text: We found no evidence that floor area increased.
